verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference service, but the evidence describes only Cerebras-operated cloud access: the public API, partner APIs and dedicated endpoints. Dedicated endpoints are private instances on reserved capacity but are still provisioned by Cerebras, so they are an adjacent feature rather than self-hosting. Nothing in the pack shows customers can run the inference stack on their own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
